theme: Dark Mode Only (The Performance Pro Archetype)

headings.rules: Tracking-tight for H1-H2. Use for page titles, league switchers, and section headers.

body.rules: Used for standard UI text, labels, and navigation.

data_and_numbers.rules: CRITICAL: Must be used for ALL odds, probabilities, EV percentages, and data tables. Monospace ensures decimal points align perfectly vertically.

primary.description: Electric Cyan. Used strictly for primary CTAs and active states.

colors.rules: Dark mode is treated as a system. Use layered elevation via background lightness (0A0A0A -> 121212 -> 1A1A1A). Keep surfaces neutral and use color exclusively for data status (Green/Yellow/Red) and the single saturated primary accent.

grids_and_layouts.strategy: High Density Grid (MODE B) for Dashboards
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Tight padding (p-4 or p-6) within cards. Use gap-4 for grids.

patterns.dashboard: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 or 12-column grid for precise spanning.
patterns.tables: w-full text-left. Use standard Shadcn table structures but strip vertical borders. Horizontal borders only.
patterns.cards: Borderless or 1px subtle border (border-border). No heavy drop shadows. Use background lightness for elevation.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Solid flat backgrounds. Minimal border-radius (max rounded-md / 6px) to maintain a sharp, technical 'terminal/analytical' look.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 1px border-border/40 to separate grid items and table rows.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used ONLY for sticky headers or dropdown menus: bg-[#0A0A0A]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.active_states: For selected tabs or rows, use a 2px left border of the primary color (Electric Cyan) or Strong Value Green to guide the eye.

component_rules.tables: Must use Shadcn Table. Hover states should slightly lighten the row background (hover:bg-white/5). Cell text must be IBM Plex Mono. Align numeric columns to the right.
component_rules.tabs: Use Shadcn Tabs for switching between (Home/Away/Overall) and windows (3/5/10). Style them minimally: transparent background with bottom border for active state.
component_rules.badges: Use for confidence ratings. Solid background with 20% opacity of the status color and 100% text color (e.g., bg-green-500/20 text-green-400).
component_rules.inputs: Quick-paste odds entry needs a highly visible focus state: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#00E5FF] focus:border-transparent. Background should be #000000.
component_rules.league_switcher: Shadcn Select/Dropdown. Must NOT have a transparent background. Must use bg-[#121212].

motion.hover: Subtle and rapid. transition-colors duration-150 ease-in-out.
motion.data_update: When new odds or EV% are pasted, the cell should briefly flash with the status color (green/red) before settling to its default state to indicate data mutation.
motion.page_transition: Simple fade in. opacity-0 to opacity-100.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure IBM Plex Mono text has at least 4.5:1 ratio against #121212. Use text-shadow if overlaying text on any gradient.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements (inputs, rows, dropdowns) must have explicit focus-visible states.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='value-scanner-row', data-testid='league-switcher').

image_urls.description: Wide-angle view of a soccer match at sunset. Dark moody atmosphere.
image_urls.category: Login Page Background / Hero Area Overlay

media.rules: Since it's a data-dense app, use images very sparingly. The soccer stadium image should ONLY be used as a full-bleed background for the Google Login screen with a heavy black overlay (bg-black/70).

3d_libraries.recommendation: Not strictly required for this table-heavy app.
3d_libraries.charts: Use Shadcn Charts (Recharts) for any line charts tracking Team Form or EV% history. Style charts with thin lines and no fill gradients to maintain high density clarity.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize data density. The Value Scanner and Form tables are the core product.
Implement the league switcher prominently in the header.
Ensure 'Correct Odds' and 'Bookmaker Line' columns are visually distinct. Highlight EV% based on the Strong/Small/No Edge status colors.
For the quick-paste odds entry, use a text area or dedicated input above the fixture that automatically parses and maps the data to the grid (mock the parsing logic if necessary, but build the UI).
Use Phosphor icons or Lucide icons for table headers (e.g., corner flag icon, trend arrows).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts. Left-align dense data.
DO NOT use dark colors as gradients. Use solid dark hex values.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Use modern button styles (sharp or max 6px radius) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus rings).
Use sonner for toast notifications (e.g., 'Odds pasted successfully').
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Missing images or logos must NOT be replaced with text placeholders. Use the provided image URLs or standard icons.
